title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：snow　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 snow 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the farmer ① cleared the snow that no child in the field would have recorded, and he said the clearing was the whole of the autumn. The ② snow, meaning the fall itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; snow, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of snow in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ snow at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Snow, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the snow was the whole of the matter, meaning the silence and not the fall. The ⑥ snow, meaning the silence and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; snow, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both fall and a silence. He said the silence is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ snow had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ snow of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of recording; snow, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ snow I remember is the snow recorded in the almanac, which closed in 1970 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. ⑩ Snow, my mother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all snow, she said, is a silence that has agreed to look like fall. She said the silence was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 雪（指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 雪（指那场雪本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the snow 扫这一场雪
D. n. 雪（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 雪之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的雪之事）
F. n. 雪（指农事历里写到、被记载的那一场）
G. n. 雪、静穆（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 静穆（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleared the snow that no child in the field would have recorded
The snow, meaning the fall itself and not the basket
Every sort of snow in that field
the snow at the far fence
the snow was the whole of the matter
the snow had become a line in an almanac
The snow of the whole thing

answers.why: clear the snow 意为“扫这一场雪”，1963 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯记载的一场雪做了一遍。
snow 意为“雪”，指那场雪本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记载。
snow 意为“雪”，指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
snow 意为“雪”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
snow 意为“雪、静穆”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场静穆就是那件事的全部。
snow 意为“静穆”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场雪，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
snow 意为“雪”，指农事历里写到、被记载的那一场，到 1968 年这一场成了农事历里的一行。
snow 意为“雪之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的雪之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的记载。
snow 意为“雪”，我记得的是农事历里记载过的那一场，1970 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一场。
snow 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，雪是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的雪。
